title: Water Damage Restoration | Gold Water Fire — Phoenix, AZ Metro
description: Water extraction, structural drying, and cleanup after leaks, pipe breaks, and flooding. Gold Water Fire serves the Phoenix, AZ metro area. Call (480) 999-3339.
intro: Extraction, drying, and cleanup after leaks, pipe breaks, water heater failures, and flooding — across the Phoenix, AZ metro area.

photo.alt: Water damage restoration technician running air movers and a dehumidifier in a flooded living room

cards.heading: Water extraction
cards.body: Standing water removed from floors, carpet, and structural cavities as soon as our crew arrives.

cards.heading: Structural drying
cards.body: Equipment placed and monitored to dry the structure and reduce the risk of secondary damage.

cards.heading: Cleanup and prep
cards.body: Affected materials cleaned or removed, and the space prepared for repair or reconstruction if needed.

sections.heading: What we respond to
sections.body: Burst or leaking pipes, water heater failures, washing machine and dishwasher supply-line failures, roof and plumbing leaks, and flooding. If a job also needs rebuild work — flooring, drywall, cabinetry — our own reconstruction team picks it up without bringing in a second contractor.

faqs.q: How fast does water damage need to be addressed?
faqs.a: Standing water and wet building materials support mold growth within 24–48 hours, so extraction and drying should start as soon as possible after the source of water is stopped.

faqs.q: Do you handle both the water damage and any repairs afterward?
faqs.a: Yes. Gold Water Fire's own reconstruction team handles framing, drywall, and flooring repair after mitigation, so you're not coordinating a second contractor.

faqs.q: What areas do you serve for water damage restoration?
faqs.a: The greater Phoenix, Arizona metro area, from Peoria and Surprise in the northwest to San Tan Valley and Apache Junction in the southeast, and the cities in between.

cta.heading: Water damage gets worse the longer it sits.
cta.body: Call Gold Water Fire to get a crew assessing the damage.

evidence: Process steps and causes are general restoration-industry practice, not GWF-specific claims. Service-area line matches Jake's confirmed 2026-08-06 boundary description in CLAIMS-TO-VERIFY.md. No certification, bonding, testimonial, or response-time number stated — none are confirmed.
